data_fields.name: damage_carry_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 1.0 (release one whole point when the carry reaches 1.0)

best_idea: Keep the fraction of every hit on the victim as server state and release a whole point only when the carried fraction reaches one, so small multipliers never silently round to zero.
decision_why: The carry only matters if Frankendom applies fractional damage; if so, it must live on the server entity, reset on respawn and stay out of the client, and the donor's armour step is absent so none is taken from it.
acceptance: A server test: three hits of 0.4 on a 10 HP defender leave it at 9 HP with 0.2 carried (the third hit takes the point); a hit of 0 leaves health and carry unchanged; an events-only defender reacts and loses no health or carry.
